vōcĭfĕrātĭo ,
			ōnis, f.
		vociferor, 
I.a loud calling, clamor,
				outcry, vociferation,
				Cic. Verr. 2, 5, 60, § 156;
				id.
				Clu. 10, 30; id. Rosc. Am. 5, 12;
					Auct. Her. 3, 12, 22;
					Petr. 14; Quint. 2,
				10, 8; Suet. Claud. 36 al.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
